body.message:
We note you have seen our previous messages but we have not received a response.

As explained, your reservation checkout date was 4th September, and the apartment owner is arriving tonight. The unit must be vacated by 12-2PM to allow for the owner's arrival.

If the apartment is not vacated by this time, we will inform building management and security of the situation. We would prefer to resolve this without further escalation, so please confirm your checkout time as soon as possible.

Thank you for your cooperation.
